description: This file contains functions related to file system metadata handling, such as munging file sizes, copying stat data, comparing stat structures, and validating file status. It appears to be part of a larger codebase that manages file attributes and their validity within a version control or file monitoring context.

methods.name: unsigned int munge_st_size(off_t st_size)
methods.description: Converts a file size into an unsigned int, adjusting sizes that are exact multiples of 4 GiB to avoid misclassification as racily clean.

methods.name: void fill_stat_data(struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Copies metadata from a struct stat into a custom struct stat_data, including timestamps, device, inode, user/group IDs, and size.

methods.name: void set_times(struct stat * st,const struct stat_data * sd)
methods.description: Sets the timestamps in a struct stat based on a given stat_data object.

methods.name: void fake_lstat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Fills a struct stat with data from a stat_data object, simulating the results of a lstat() call.

methods.name: int match_stat_data(const struct stat_data * sd,struct stat * st)
methods.description: Compares stat_data with a struct stat, returning flags indicating differences in mtime, ctime, owner, inode, device, or size.

methods.name: void stat_validity_clear(struct stat_validity * sv)
methods.description: Frees and nullifies the stored stat_data in a stat_validity object.

methods.name: int stat_validity_check(struct stat_validity * sv,const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if the stored stat_data matches current file status for a given path, returning validity status.

methods.name: void stat_validity_update(struct stat_validity * sv,int fd)
methods.description: Updates the stat_validity object with current file metadata obtained via fstat.

ctags.name: set_times
ctags.pattern: /^static void set_times(struct stat *st, const struct stat_data *sd)$/
